1. Gangnam-gu.plastic: Rinse clean, remove vinyl labels and caps. Place in transparent bags.
1. Gangnam-gu.paper: Flatten cardboard boxes, remove tape and spiral binders from notebooks.
1. Gangnam-gu.glass: Rinse empty bottles. Do not break or shatter glass.
1. Gangnam-gu.organic: Drain all water completely. Use designated YELLOW food waste bags.
1. Gangnam-gu.general: Dispose in WHITE / BEIGE Gangnam-gu general trash bags.

2. Mapo-gu.plastic: Clean out food residues. Separate clear PET bottles from colored plastic.
2. Mapo-gu.paper: Keep dry, fold cardboard boxes neatly.
2. Mapo-gu.glass: Remove caps, dispose in clear glass recycling containers.
2. Mapo-gu.metal: Crush food and drink cans before disposal.
2. Mapo-gu.organic: Drain moisture completely. Use PINK Mapo-gu food waste bags.
2. Mapo-gu.general: Dispose in WHITE Mapo-gu standard waste bags.

3. Yongsan-gu.plastic: Remove labels and caps. Dispose in transparent recycling bags.
3. Yongsan-gu.paper: Bundle paper items together. Keep completely dry.
3. Yongsan-gu.glass: Empty and rinse out glass containers.
3. Yongsan-gu.organic: Use ORANGE Yongsan-gu food waste bags after draining liquids.
3. Yongsan-gu.general: Dispose in WHITE Yongsan-gu general trash bags.

4. Jongno-gu.plastic: Separate labels and place in transparent plastic recycling bags.
4. Jongno-gu.paper: Remove tape, stickers, and metal notebook bindings.
4. Jongno-gu.glass: Rinse out liquids. Do not mix with heat-resistant glass or bulbs.
4. Jongno-gu.metal: Crush metal cans to save space.
4. Jongno-gu.organic: Use YELLOW Jongno-gu food waste bags.
4. Jongno-gu.general: Use standard WHITE Jongno-gu volume-rate bags.

5. Seongdong-gu.plastic: Rinse plastic containers thoroughly before disposal.
5. Seongdong-gu.paper: Flatten boxes and tie dry paper with string.
5. Seongdong-gu.glass: Empty contents and dispose in glass collection bins.
5. Seongdong-gu.metal: Place clean cans in metal collection containers.
5. Seongdong-gu.organic: Use BLUE Seongdong-gu food waste bags.

6. Gwanak-gu.plastic: Separate clear PET bottles into dedicated collection bins.
6. Gwanak-gu.paper: Remove non-paper elements like tape or plastic wrapping.
6. Gwanak-gu.glass: Rinse and dispose in designated glass recycling bins.
6. Gwanak-gu.metal: Flatten clean tin and aluminum cans.
6. Gwanak-gu.organic: Use YELLOW Gwanak-gu food waste bags.
6. Gwanak-gu.general: Use WHITE Gwanak-gu standard volume bags.

7. Seodaemun-gu.plastic: Rinse thoroughly and remove all adhesive labels.
7. Seodaemun-gu.paper: Keep dry and bundle cardboard securely.
7. Seodaemun-gu.glass: Clean thoroughly before disposing in glass bins.
7. Seodaemun-gu.organic: Use PINK or YELLOW Seodaemun-gu food waste bags.
7. Seodaemun-gu.general: Use WHITE Seodaemun-gu general trash bags.

8. Seongbuk-gu.plastic: Dispose in clear transparent bags after rinsing.
8. Seongbuk-gu.paper: Flatten boxes and bind dry paper neatly.
8. Seongbuk-gu.organic: Use GREEN Seongbuk-gu food waste bags.
8. Seongbuk-gu.general: Use WHITE Seongbuk-gu standard trash bags.

9. Dongdaemun-gu.plastic: Clean out residue, detach plastic film labels.
9. Dongdaemun-gu.paper: Fold boxes flat and remove adhesive tape.
9. Dongdaemun-gu.glass: Rinse out liquids and dispose safely.
9. Dongdaemun-gu.metal: Puncture aerosol cans in ventilated areas before disposal.
9. Dongdaemun-gu.organic: Use ORANGE Dongdaemun-gu food waste bags.
9. Dongdaemun-gu.general: Use WHITE Dongdaemun-gu general waste bags.

10. Songpa-gu.plastic: Separate clear PET bottles from general plastics.
10. Songpa-gu.glass: Remove caps and labels where possible.
10. Songpa-gu.organic: Use YELLOW Songpa-gu food waste bags or RFID bins.
10. Songpa-gu.general: Use official WHITE Songpa-gu trash bags.
